revisions.note: Added the data (.eeg) and marker (.vmrk) file each header names (DataFile, MarkerFile) (684 files, 4595608312 bytes); the original sourcedata snapshot held only the 342 BrainVision headers (subjectXX/matrixSpeller_Block*_Run*.vhdr). Source: Zenodo record 5831826 (10.5281/zenodo.5831826), members of the per-subject archives subjectXX.zip. Each archive was downloaded from Zenodo and checked against the size and MD5 the Zenodo API publishes; members were extracted with their CRC-32 checked. Every header already in the deposit is byte-identical (SHA-256) to its member in the same archive.
